title: 9 Beliefs Behind
My <g>AI Work</g>
subtitle: What I won't trade for speed. One line each.

cards.title: Find, Fix, then Automate
cards.body: Watch the work, make it simpler, then decide what AI does.

cards.title: The simplest thing wins
cards.body: Fewer parts, tools you already have, less to maintain.

cards.title: One thing at a time
cards.body: One workflow to prove first. One next step.

cards.title: Lower your risk first
cards.body: A small step that proves one thing beats a big promise.

cards.title: Find where you're stuck
cards.body: Then turn it around. That's where the best work starts.

cards.title: Show it working
cards.body: A running system beats a plan in a slide deck.

cards.title: Real numbers only
cards.body: No number yet? It says "to be measured". Never invented.

cards.title: Give first
cards.body: Help without an ask. The deal comes from the relationship.

cards.title: You own it at the end
cards.body: It runs in your business, without me in the loop.
